title: The support of a finite type quasi-coherent module on an algebraic space is closed and computes by stalks
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-morphisms.tex (Morphisms of Algebraic Spaces)
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file spaces-morphisms.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma with three assertions for a finite type quasi-coherent module F on an algebraic space X: its support is closed, membership of a point x in the support is equivalent to nonvanishing of the stalk at a geometric point and of its tensor with the residue field, and pullback along any morphism of algebraic spaces is again of finite type with support the preimage (source lines 3051-3071). Closedness is descended from the scheme case through a surjective etale U -> X using that the preimage of the support is the support of the pullback; the second assertion is the definition plus Nakayama; the third computes the stalk of the pullback as a tensor product and reduces nonvanishing to the corresponding statement on X.
